title: Crowding on DNA modulates SSB protein binding mode kinetics
authors: Alberto Pérez-Mugía; Bruno Marcos; Juan P.G. Villaluenga; Borja Ibarra; Francisco J. Cao-García
one_liner_zh: 该文通过动力学模型研究SSB蛋白与单链DNA的多模式结合及拥挤效应，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作，方法为理论建模而非AI或MD，对TF-DNA互作建模有借鉴但非直接聚焦。
abstract: Single-stranded DNA-binding (SSB) proteins play a crucial role in DNA replication by binding to single-stranded DNA (ssDNA) in multiple binding modes, depending on conditions such as salt and protein concentrations. The coverage-dependent effects on the kinetics of these binding modes remain incompletely understood. In particular, the bimodal binding kinetics and the further SSB-ssDNA shortening observed when SSB is removed from the media. Here, we develop a kinetic model extending the Tonks-McGhee-von Hippel framework to incorporate ligand crowding and mode transformations, capturing the inhibition of SSB binding and transitions to higher binding modes as coverage increases. This model quantitatively reproduces experimental binding kinetics and coverage-dependent behaviors observed for human mitochondrial SSB (HmtSSB) and E. coli SSB (EcoSSB). Our findings elucidate the impact of ligand crowding on SSB-ssDNA interactions and provide a generalizable framework for studying multimode ligand binding to polymers, with implications for understanding genome maintenance mechanisms. GRAPHICAL ABSTRACT
abstract_zh: 单链DNA结合（SSB）蛋白在DNA复制中发挥关键作用，通过多种结合模式与单链DNA（ssDNA）结合，具体模式取决于盐浓度和蛋白质浓度等条件。这些结合模式在动力学上受覆盖度依赖效应的影响，目前尚未完全理解。特别是，当SSB从培养基中移除时，观察到的双峰结合动力学以及进一步的SSB-ssDNA缩短现象。在此，我们开发了一个动力学模型，扩展了Tonks-McGhee-von Hippel框架，以纳入配体拥挤和模式转换，捕捉到随着覆盖度增加SSB结合的抑制及向更高结合模式的转变。该模型定量重现了人线粒体SSB（HmtSSB）和大肠杆菌SSB（EcoSSB）的实验结合动力学及覆盖度依赖行为。我们的发现阐明了配体拥挤对SSB-ssDNA相互作用的影响，并为研究聚合物上多模式配体结合提供了一个可推广的框架，对理解基因组维持机制具有重要意义。图形摘要
